Date: 2027-04-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding sprint plan for Palmetto Analytics

Team / Samira —

Attaching the first-pass onboarding sprint plan and a short MAP that we discussed during the demo. High-level objectives: get a private deployment in VPC with KMS-integrated keys, validate latency on a 10k qps baseline, and enable the first two ML features (summarization + semantic search) by the go-live date.

Requested next steps from our side:
- CS kickoff (30–45m) to align owners and sprint cadence
- Customer technical kickoff for network/VPC design
- Finalize SOW and DocuSign flow (Procurement loop)

Attachment: Palmetto-MAP-v1.2.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, target dates)
Attachment: SOW_draft_20270418.pdf (draft SOW for review)

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira@palmetto.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding sprint plan for Palmetto Analytics

Thanks Rishi — nice draft. Samira / Jorge, welcome — excited to kick this off.

I propose the following concrete 4-week sprint breakdown so CS/Eng has clear checkpoints:

Sprint 0 (Pre-kickoff, Apr 19–Apr 23) — alignment & SOW
- Confirm final SOW sign-off (Procurement) — owner: Palmetto procurement — target: Apr 22
- Agree on primary contacts and escalation path — owner: Evelyn — target: Apr 21

Sprint 1 (Provisioning, Apr 24–May 7) — infra & network
- VPC peering and firewall rules validated — owner: Dev — target: May 4
- KMS integration test (key exchange + rotation doc) — owner: Dev/Palmetto SecOps — target: May 7

Sprint 2 (Core integration, May 8–May 21) — models + auth
- Model variant selection & quantization profile applied — owner: CS/Infra — target: May 14
- Token-level telemetry & tracing enabled in staging — owner: Marissa/Dev — target: May 21

Sprint 3 (Acceptance & go-live prep, May 22–Jun 4)
- Performance validation at target QPS — owner: CS/Infra — target: May 28
- Final acceptance test + go/no-go decision — owner: Palmetto PM — target: Jun 2

Please review and confirm owners/targets. I'll schedule the CS kickoff tomorrow (Apr 19) at 10:00 PT unless I hear objections.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Agree with the sprint structure — small clarifications from CS and suggested resourcing:

CS owners and slack channels:
- Primary CS: Marissa Cole (marissa_cs_palmetto@redwood.com) — overall MAP owner
- Technical CS engineer: Jordan Blake (will be assigned to the Palmetto workspace) — responsible for model validation and acceptance tests
- Weekly touchpoint: Wednesdays 9:00 PT (standing) starting Apr 21

Dependencies we need from Palmetto by Apr 24:
- Network diagram + VPC CIDR ranges (required for peering)
- KMS key contact and instructive on rotation windows
- A list of sample prompt sets for acceptance perf tests

I also captured a short SOC2 evidence request in a spreadsheet (SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx) — Palmetto SecOps will need to review.

Forwarding to Dev for technical milestones and to confirm the provisioning ETA.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Samira Khan <samira@palmetto.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding sprint plan for Palmetto Analytics

Thanks — confirm technical plan and owners below. I can take the provisioning work with one infra engineer (assigned: Lukas Meyer). Proposed technical milestones with owners/dates: 

1) Network prep & approvals (Dev, Lukas) — target May 4
- Receive VPC CIDR + peering firewall rules from Palmetto (by Apr 24)
- Create and share subnet diagram, NAT/Egress rules, and test plan

2) KMS integration & key exchange (Dev + Palmetto SecOps) — target May 7
- Provide key import instructions and IAM policy snippets

3) Staging deployment + telemetry (Dev + Jordan Blake) — target May 14
- Deploy model variant v1.2-quant to staging cluster
- Enable token-level tracing; share sample traces with Palmetto for sign-off

4) Performance runbook and load test (Dev + Jordan) — target May 28
- Run latency/QPS validation and document results; include mitigation plan if 95p latency > SLO

Note: if procurement needs an IP allowlist for Marketplace registration, loop procurement@palmetto.ai to coordinate. I’ll add these milestones to the MAP spreadsheet and push updated estimates.

Dev Patel
Staff Engineer, Infra | Redwood Inference

- Palmetto: please confirm VPC ranges + KMS contact by Apr 24 (Samira / Jorge)

I'll send the DocuSign SOW link once procurement confirms the redline owner. Please reply in-thread to accept these owners/dates; once everyone replies I will mark the MAP as "accepted" and create HubSpot milestones.

Next meeting: CS kickoff — Apr 21 09:00 PT (invitation sent)

Thanks — excited to get Palmetto into staging quickly.

Rishi Malhotra
